blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines– The 2026-27 NBA season continued Wednesday, November 25 (November 24 US time) with the Celtics snapping a four-game skid, the Pistons dealing the Magic their first NBA Cup loss and the Mavericks routing the Nuggets. Boston Celtics beat Washington Wizards, 131-116 Jayson Tatum erupted for 41 points, scoring 28 in the first half, to lead Boston. Paul George added 28 points, while Neemias Queta contributed 21. Anthony Davis led Washington with 33 points and 13 rebounds. Kyshawn George added 24, while rookie AJ Dybantsa posted 20 points, 11 rebounds and seven assists.
